 De'Aaron Fox fills stat sheet Saturday against Mavericks 
 by Chris Schommer | Spurs Correspondent | Sun, Oct 25th 2026, 4:17pm EDT 
 De'Aaron Fox filled the stat sheet for the Spurs Saturday night, dishing out nine assists, recording three steals, grabbing three rebounds, blocking one shot, and scoring 19 points (6-11 FG, 2-4 3PT, 5-7 FT) in a 122-106 win over the Mavericks. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Fox has been solid on the offensive end of the floor to begin the season, finishing with seven or more assists and 14 or more points in each of the first three contests. The guard offers head coach Mitch Johnson another dynamic option as part of a deep San Antonio lineup, averaging 17.3 points, 4.7 rebounds, and 8.3 assists per game to go along with a usage rate of 19.2% so far this season.
